instruction: Disable 'Save window positions on exit' in GIMP's preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling window position saving via Edit > Preferences > Window Management. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for '(restore session no)' entry. Similar difficulty to original theme change task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: disabling 'Save window positions on exit' preference in GIMP
Postconfig properly closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config changes are persisted to disk - this is critical for GIMP preferences
Getter logic correctly extracts the gimprc config file from standard GIMP location (~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc)
Metric logic correctly parses GIMP config format and checks for '(restore session no)' entry with key=['restore', 'session'] and value='no'
Expected value is semantically correct - 'restore session no' is the correct GIMP config setting for disabling window position saving
Complete coverage - the single instruction requirement is fully verified by the evaluator
Data flow is correct: config file extraction -> parsing -> verification of specific setting
Evaluator will work correctly at runtime - all components are logically sound and compatible
